pages.text: One breezy evening, <name> was in the garden blowing soap bubbles that sparkled in the sunset. “Biggest one yet!” he said, dipping his wand into the soapy water.
But this time, when he blew gently — whoooosh! — a gigantic bubble grew and grew until it was taller than the mango tree!
Before <name> could step back, the bubble whooped around him — and up he floated into the sky! “Wait—what just happened?!” he laughed, waving goodbye to his astonished cat below.

The bubble shimmered rainbow colors as it floated past clouds and stars. Soon, <name> was in outer space! All around him were other glowing bubbles — each holding something inside! Tiny green aliens had a picnic in one, while another played zero-gravity hopscotch.

“Hi there!” <name> called. “Blip-blop-hello!” the aliens replied, giggling through their see-through bubbles. They played space tag, bounced on star dust, and laughed as their bubbles bobbed gently around Saturn’s rings.
But suddenly — pffffft! — one of the alien’s bubbles began to deflate! “Oh no! Blip’s bubble is popping!” cried the smallest alien. Thinking fast, <name> pulled out his bubble wand.

“Quick — everyone blow together!” The aliens puffed tiny bursts of cosmic air while <name> dipped his wand into stardust foam and blew the biggest rescue bubble ever! It wrapped around Blip just in time. “Teamwork saves the galaxy!” <name> cheered.
Soon, his giant bubble drifted back toward Earth. The aliens waved. “Visit again, Earth boy!” With a pop! <name> landed safely in his backyard — covered in glittery stardust and smiling wide.

He looked up at the night sky and whispered, “Imagination and science can take us anywhere — even to the stars in a bubble!” And from that day on, every bubble he blew shimmered just a little brighter.
